answer: Mechanism: Neighborhood-Entropy Admission. Existing agents run k short random walks from an applicant’s edges, salted separately with walnut, yarrow, sparrow. Admission uses endpoint entropy and return-path overlap, not credentials. Sybil clusters show low entropy and high internal overlap, so fail. Attacker cost: O(k·N) diverse, live external edges across separate communities plus sustained traffic, not just N keys.
